163.news_title: New 4x3 Aspect Ratio Monitors are now shipping - the Latest Schedules
163.long_description:
We are shipping….

Earlier this week the assembly plant was closed due to the typhoon, and has affected our shipping dates. For our pre order customers, please note;

-	35inch UHD 2880x2160 monitors, have started shipping 
-	32inch 1920x1080 monitors, have started shipping
-	32inch with metal frame/glass, have started shipping
-	26inch HD 1440x1080 monitors, will ship on Monday
-	35inch HD 1440x1080 monitors, will ship after the Chinese New Year
-	26inch UHD 2880x2160 monitors, will ship late in October
-	20inch 1600x1200 monitors, will ship late in October

Various models are in quality control testing prior to shipping - will be shipping in the order received.  We are sorry for the additional delays but will keep all pre-order customers informed over this next period. 

For new order customers (subject to available stock, or if at all);

-	32inch 1920x1080 monitors, available from 17th October
-	32inch with metal frame/glass, available from 17th October
- 	35inch UHD 2880x2160 monitors, available from 17th October 
-	26inch HD 1440x1080 monitors, available from 17th October
-	35inch HD 1440x1080 monitors, available from 30th October
-	26inch UHD 2880x2160 monitors, available from 5th November


This is the most updated information received on Sunday, 28th September, 2025.
163.short_description: The 26inch and 35inch UHD and HD LCD monitors with 4x3 aspect ratio are now shipping. Due to the recent typhoon, the delivery dates have moved. Please review the latest schedules.
